# voice — __NAME__

Shaped empty by `onboard-stream __SLUG__` on __DATE__; the headings mirror the
root stream's `voice.md` and carry none of its content. Filled only by
`/corpus-update --apply --stream __SLUG__`, tighten-only, from this stream's
own briefs.

Not written yet. Until this file carries a voice, the stream drafts nothing.

**The rule that binds every voice file.** Streams are isolated: this voice
never merges with another stream's in a single output, never borrows its
vocabulary, and names another stream only under a pair rule in
`.atelier/memory/streams.md`. If a line reads as two narrators, it fails.
